rules.rule: Use navy, deep blue, or dark teal as primary color. Trust is communicated through color restraint — avoid bright or playful palettes. Structured mood with high information density.
Financial data must be scannable: large account balance at top, transaction list with clear debit/credit color coding (red/green), monospaced font for amounts.
Primary CTA (Send, Pay, Transfer) must be full-width, high-contrast, bottom of screen. Never bury critical actions in menus.
Include security signal elements: lock icon near actions, SSL badge on login, masked account numbers (••••1234). Users must feel protected at every step.
Bottom navigation with 4 items max: Home, Cards, Send/Pay, Profile. No hamburger menus — everything must be reachable in 2 taps.
